'Dundee Utd want permenent Cameron signing' - gossip
- Published
Dundee United are reportedly keen to keep Rangers' Lyall Cameron permanently, while Scott McKenna looks certain to miss Scotland's next Nations League games through injury.
Dundee United are interested in signing 24-year-old on-loan Rangers midfielder Lyall Cameron permanently. (Football Insider, external)
Dylan Tait has revealed he knocked back moves to England, including Barnsley and Plymouth Argyle, to sign for Dundee United after the 24-year-old midfielder left Falkirk this summer. (Daily Record, external)
Rangers midfielder Thelo Aasgaard has received glowing praise from the media in Belgium after the 24-year-old scored his first goal for loan club Anderlecht in their 4-1 win over Westerlo. (The National, external)
Former Rangers midfielder Joe Aribo is still seeking a new club five months after the 30-year-old Nigeria international was released by Southampton. (Scottish Sun, external)
On-loan Bournemouth defender Matai Akinmboni feels "blessed" after the 20-year-old made his first professional appearance in two-and-a-half years in Dundee's win over Kilmarnock last week. (The Courier, external)
- Monday's English & European transfer rumours 
  - Published8 hours ago
- Sunday's Scottish Gossip 
  - Published21 hours ago
Scotland will almost certainly be without centre-half Scott McKenna for the Nations League games later this month after his Dinamo Zagreb head coach confirmed the 29-year-old will be out for two weeks. (Scottish Sun, external)
Dundee United left-back Kevin Ciubotaru, who has one cap for Romania, hopes his superb start to life at Tannadice will earn a recall by catching the eye of national head coach Gheorghe Hagi. (The Courier, external)
St Johnstone head coach Simo Valakari has revealed that goalscorer Danny Schmidt's injured ankle is in a "horrible state" after the German striker played on for the final 20 minutes against Kilmarnock. (The Courier, external)
Danny Schmidt says there was no way he coming off against Kilmarnock when he learned St Johnstone had no more substitutes to introduce despite finished his first full game for the club barely able to walk, never mind run. (The Courier, external)

דנדי יונייטד מביעה עניין רב בהחתמתו הקבועה של קשר ריינג'רס, ליאל קמרון בן ה-24, אשר משחק בימים אלו בקבוצה בהשאלה. במקביל, נבחרת סקוטלנד תיאלץ ככל הנראה להסתדר במשחקי ליגת האומות הקרובים ללא השחקן סקוט מקקנה, לאחר שמאמנו בדינמו זאגרב אישר כי הוא צפוי להיעדר לתקופה של שבועיים בשל פציעה.

בגזרת העברות נוספת, דילן טייט חשף כי דחה הצעות מקבוצות באנגליה כמו בארנסלי ופליימות ארגייל כדי להצטרף לדנדי יונייטד הקיץ. כמו כן, קשר ריינג'רס תלו אאסגור זכה לשבחים בתקשורת בבלגיה לאחר שכבש את שער הבכורה שלו במדי אנדרלכט, בעוד המגן המושאל מבורנמות, מטאיי אקיממבוני, רשם את הופעתו המקצוענית הראשונה מזה שנתיים וחצי בניצחון דנדי על קילמרנוק.
